name: NewlyRenovated_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving into a newly renovated apartment before all rooms are finished

setting.relationship_dynamic: Partners moving into a home undergoing final renovations
setting.background: The apartment is mostly complete, but painting and flooring work in one room is still underway
setting.conversation_style: Planning around an imperfect and changing environment

scenario_template.topic: Preparing to move into the renovated home
scenario_template.note: They discuss the renovation progress and their planned moving date. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Which rooms can be used first
scenario_template.note: They identify finished rooms that can receive boxes and furniture. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

A contractor announces that one unfinished room will take several additional days. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They ask how to avoid having boxes and furniture interfere with the remaining renovation. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.
No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Furniture arrives before the room is ready
scenario_template.note: A large furniture delivery cannot be postponed easily. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

They create a temporary arrangement until the renovation is fully complete. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.
